title: Delegation worktrees default inside the source repository (Git-ignored), never under ~/.termal/delegations
outcome: Every delegation worktree TermAl creates lives inside its own source repository, in a Git-ignored directory, together with its build output and test data. Nothing is created under the TermAl data directory. Removing it after the delegation ends is w-e91aa9129c63.
acceptance: Behavioral regression: an isolated-worktree delegation with no explicit path creates its worktree at <source repo root>/.worktrees/d-<first 12 hex of the delegation id>, a Git-ignored directory agreed by both projects' coordinators, and nothing under the TermAl data dir. The path is portable (Windows, Linux, macOS) and documented. A repo where .worktrees/ is not ignored is refused with a bounded readable reason, never written outside the repo. On Windows, a worktree whose Git administrative directory path would exceed Git's 220-character limit is refused before git worktree add runs, with a bounded readable reason, and nothing is created.

An explicit worktree path is accepted only inside the source repository; a path outside it is refused with a bounded, readable reason naming the allowed location. No exception directory outside the repo exists.

docs/features describes the default location and the in-repo-only rule for explicit paths. The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.

completion.summary: Delegation worktrees now default to <source repo>/.worktrees/d-<12 hex>, inside the repository and Git-ignored, with explicit paths limited to ignored locations inside the repository and a Windows $GIT_DIR length refusal before creation. Landed as 007bf5bb (gate EB21-LOC7-FULL-1 test-caa4ab3b PASS; Linux test-f24ea274 and Windows legs PASS; round-3 review pair clean, Lows filed as w-39c05805be7e and w-8ef7d7b49bd4). The DL560 delegations listing stayed 42/42 on the landing FULL, confirming the leak is gone. Post-landing evaluation passed all 3 criteria. Automatic removal of ended worktrees continues in w-e91aa9129c63.
